parameters.content:
## 1 · Triggers (4 ways in)
**Web page** (webhook), **n8n form**, **Telegram chat** and the **daily schedule**.
All four end in the same *Settings* node.

## Chat trigger + AI
A message to the Telegram bot goes to Gemini, which turns plain words into the same filters the web page sends.
Only the Telegram user ID(s) listed in the trigger can use the bot.

## 2 · API call: YouTube Data API
Search, fetch stats, skip videos already in the database, keep the best.

## Database: clipped_videos
Every video that was sent to Vizard is saved here, so the same video is never clipped twice.

## 3 · Sub-workflow: Clip One Video
Vizard clipping runs in its own workflow, once per video, so each video gets a fresh 60-check limit.

## 4 · Delivery
One email with download + edit links. No clips means no email.

## One-time setup
Click *Execute workflow* on this trigger once to create the clipped_videos table. Safe to run twice. Delete these two nodes afterwards.

messageValues.message:
You turn a short chat message into filters for a YouTube clipping tool.
Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else: no markdown, no explanation.

Set "isClipRequest" to true only if the message asks to find or clip YouTube videos. For a greeting, a question or anything else, reply {"isClipRequest": false} and nothing more.

Keys you may add (leave out any key the message does not mention, never guess):
"Keyword (optional)": a few search words, for example "football interview"
"What should the clips be about?": the kind of moments to clip, if the message says
"Language": English, Spanish, French, German or Portuguese
"Region": US, GB, FR, CA, DE or IN
"Category": Any, Comedy, Sport, News & Politics, Education, Entertainment, People & Blogs or Gaming
"Published within": Last 24 hours, Last week, Last month, Last year or Last 5 years
"Sort by": Most viewed, Most recent or Best match
"Minimum views": Any, 100k+, 1M+ or 10M+
"Max video length": 5 minutes, 10 minutes, 15 minutes or 20 minutes
"Number of videos": 1, 2 or 3
"Clips per video": 3, 5 or 10
"Clip length": Auto, Under 30s, 30-60s or 60-90s
"Aspect ratio": 9:16 Vertical (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), 1:1 Square or 16:9 Horizontal
"Email": an email address, only if the message contains one

Use the option text exactly as written above.

Example message: 2 french podcast videos about football, 3 clips each, send to sam@example.com
Example reply: {"isClipRequest": true, "Language": "French", "Keyword (optional)": "podcast football", "Number of videos": "2", "Clips per video": "3", "Email": "sam@example.com"}
